doc: Byte-comparison routine (memcmp-like): compares n bytes at p1/p2. Returns -1 if n==0. Otherwise loops decrementing n first (while(--n) shape); on the first mismatching byte returns (int)*p1-(int)*p2 immediately; if all bytes through n-1 match, falls out of loop and returns (int)*p1-(int)*p2 for the final byte pair unconditionally (no equality check on the last pair).
